name: hoppingheads
description: Hopping Heads - repo root. Tooling and gate only; the server manifest lives in server/package.json.

scripts.gate: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run build
scripts.build: npm run sync && npm run check-sync
scripts.check-sync: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),a=fs.readFileSync('client/index.html'),b=fs.readFileSync('server/public/index.html');if(!a.equals(b)){console.error('[check-sync] OUT OF SYNC: run npm run sync');process.exit(1)}console.log('[check-sync] OK')"
